desc:

Two beautiful unfurnished rooms are available for one person in a unique two-level apartment in the top floors of a charming four-storey home. The rooms offer tons of natural light and are perfect for someone who wants the flexibility of a separate bedroom and office, creative space, or extra storage.
The house has an amazing patio with incredible views of the North Shore Mountains—ideal for morning coffee or winding down in the evening. While the rooms are currently unfurnished, one can be equipped with a bed frame and desk if needed.

- Utilities; high-speed WiFi
- Fully equipped kitchen ( but there is space if you want to bring some equipment)
- Street parking (free!)
- Built-in closets in both rooms
- Month-to-month rental (flexible move-in from August 1,15 or Sept 1)

The shared spaces (kitchen, bathroom, and dining room) are also on the main floor, while my private living area is upstairs, which allows for extra privacy and separation. There is a small laundry available in the house.
BONUS: You’ll be sharing the space with Monty, a sweet 13-year-old Maine Coon mix. She's calm, affectionate, and a wonderful housemate in her own right. 🐾

We also share access to a lovely garden with the other tenants in the building, and we all have a friendly, respectful relationship.
📍 Location Perks:
- Quiet, green neighborhood near Oak & 22nd
- Safeway just 3 blocks away
- Douglas Park around the corner (incl gym).
- Easy transit: the 25 (to UBC) is 2 blocks away, the 17 (to downtown) stops at the corner, and King Edward Station (Canada Line) is a 13-minute walk

👋 About me:
 I (she/her) am an artist and work in arts administration at a Vancouver university. I also have a studio space in a different part of the city that I go to weekly. I spend ample time outside of the house and on some days I work from home. I value a calm and respectful living space. I enjoy occasional chats, shared meals or drinks, some gatherings with friends but also highly respect alone time and personal space.
You are ideally a person with a positive vibe, that is comfortable in a new space with a roommate and can share any concerns or issues respectfully and openly. For me it is important that everyone in the home feels heard and respected. The space will give lots of room and privacy for everyone to move around. I hope to find someone that will feel very comfortable in the home and also tidy, responsible and trustworthy.

If that sounds like you, I’d love to connect!
Feel free to reach out with any questions or if your move-in date is a little earlier or later—there’s some flexibility.
